why:
Must_catch item 2 is handled. Check 2 runs the commands "both at the PR head and at the PR's base commit" and compares stdout, stderr and exit status against the base.

Item 1 is not handled. Check 4 does say the line depends on a merge. But it bases PASS on the live page: "curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ | grep ... PASS: the published page ... contains --shout". If the PR isn't merged yet, the check just says to "report FAIL" as "not yet verifiable". It never checks at the PR head what will publish the page, meaning that docs/index.md lists --shout and that pages.yml publishes docs/ from main. Pages.yml shows up only in an advisory note, and Check 4 doesn't use it. So the brief misses one of the two items.
